name: Tsugimoto Ooka
source:
A gunslinger who is loyal and protective of Rohan, her childhood friend. She thinks Rohan can be unreasonable and out of control, but loves her anyway and feels she is important to her.

Hobbies: Admiring her gun, comedy, watching movies (the ones with quick draw pistols)
Special skills: Shooting, sharp tsukkomi

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689052]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler] When she was a child, she accidentally shot her mother while practising with a pistol and blinded her. [/spoiler]
